$P = \{x \in \mathbb{N} : 2 < x \le 6\} = \{3, 4, 5, 6\}$
$Q = \{x \in \mathbb{N} : x \text{ is even and } x \le 8\} = \{2, 4, 6, 8\}$

The set to be determined is $\{4, 6\}$

If there is no element common to any two sets, then these two sets are called **disjoint sets**. Let $A$ and $B$ be two sets. If $A \cap B = \emptyset$ then $A$ and $B$ are said to be mutually disjoint sets.

$A = \{m, n\}$ is a set. Subsets of $A$ are $\{m, n\}, \{m\}, \{n\}, \emptyset$, and set of all sets $\{\{m, n\}, \{m\}, \{n\}, \emptyset\}$ of $A$ is called **power set** of $A$. Power set of $A$ is denoted by $P(A)$. So the set formed by all subsets of a set is called power set of a given set.

Example 10. Find the number of elements of the power sets $A = \emptyset, B = \{a\}, C = \{a, b\}$.

Solution: Here $P(A) = \{\emptyset\}$
$\therefore$ number of elements of $A$ is $0$ and number of elements of its power set is $= 1 = 2^0$

Again $P(B) = \{\{a\}, \emptyset\}$
$\therefore$ number of elements of $B$ is $1$, and number of elements of its power set is $= 2 = 2^1$.

and $P(C) = \{\{a\}, \{b\}, \{a, b\}, \emptyset\}$
$\therefore$ number of elements of $C$ is $2$ and number of elements of its power set is $= 4 = 2^2$

So, if number of elements of a set is $n$, then number of elements of its power set is $2^n$.
